newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong economy seen growing by 5.5 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong economy seen growing by 5.5 pct in 1997.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Thursday he expected gross domestic product to grow by 5.5 percent in 1997 from 4.7 percent in 1996.

"(This) simply represents our best, objective estimate of how the Hong Kong economy will perform during the current year," Tsang told the Hong Kong Investment Fund Association in a speech called "Hong Kong 1997 Economic Outlook".
